claim: The framework assesses relative credit and macro-financial vulnerability of Indian semiconductor exposures.
The framework stress-tests semiconductor bank exposures under adverse conditions.
The framework provides indicative bank credit decision-support grades.
The framework incorporates project, macro, borrower and portfolio dimensions.
The banking layer supports credit review, exposure management and monitoring.
The model predicts the probability that a semiconductor borrower will default.
The model predicts actual future NPAs.
Indicative A-E grades are official bank or CRA credit ratings.
The framework autonomously approves or rejects bank loans.
A reduction in the constructed portfolio stress index equals an equivalent reduction in actual credit losses.
